tags.value:
@epdoc/fmt - Factory functions for formatting common data types for display.

Provides color-aware formatter factories for boolean, byte-size, percentage,
and duration values. Each factory returns a closure that applies formatting
and optional ANSI coloring. Designed for use with table column formatters
and message builders.

tags.doc:
```ts
import { bool, bytes, percent, uptime } from '@epdoc/fmt';

percent()(0.5);            // "50.00 %"
bytes()(1048576);          // "1.0 MiB"
uptime()(3661);            // "1h01m01s"
bool()(true);              // "✓" (green)
char()('check');           // "✓"
char()('left');            // "←"

// With sub-path imports
import { bool } from '@epdoc/fmt/bool';
```

Factory function that creates a boolean formatter.
Renders boolean values as styled characters or text with configurable presets.

tags.name: options

A formatter function compatible with Column.formatter
If a preset name that is not in {@link BOOL_PRESETS} is passed

jsDoc.doc:
Predefined boolean display styles for table columns.
Each preset specifies distinct characters for true/false values along with their colors.
Most presets use different characters so they remain distinguishable in no-color mode;
presets like `circleRed` rely on color alone and collapse to a single character when
colors are stripped.
Options for boolean formatter.
Character or string to display for truthy values. Default: '✓'
Character or string to display for falsy values. Default: '✗'
Hex color for truthy values. Default: 0x51d67c (green)
Hex color for falsy values. Default: 0xef5867 (red)
Apply bold intensity to the rendered character. Default: false
Apply dim intensity to the rendered character. Default: false
Inferred preset name type from {@link BOOL_PRESETS}.

Runtime mapping of every preset name to itself, useful for iterating over or
dynamically looking up preset names. Prefer the {@link BoolPreset} type for
static usage.
Runtime mapping of bool preset names to themselves.
Name of a predefined bool preset.
Options for configuring the byte-size formatter.
Number of decimal places (default: 1)
Separator between value and unit (default: ' ')
Optional hex color for the unit suffix (e.g., 0x888888)

Factory function that creates a percentage formatter.
Converts a ratio (0..1) to a percentage string.

tags.name: options
tags.doc: Formatting options or number of decimals for backward compat

jsDoc.doc: Options for configuring the percentage formatter.
Number of decimal places (default: 2)
Separator between value and percent sign (default: ' ')
Optional hex color for the percent sign (e.g., 0x888888)

Factory function that creates an uptime/duration formatter.
Formats seconds elapsed into compact narrow format using @epdoc/duration.
Options for configuring the uptime/duration formatter.
Separator between value and unit (default: '')
Optional hex color for unit suffixes (e.g., 0x888888)
Number of time units to display (default: 3)
Superscript digit glyphs indexed by digit (0-9).
Subscript digit glyphs indexed by digit (0-9).
Superscript letter glyphs (common ones).
Unicode vulgar fraction glyphs keyed by slash form (e.g. '1/2').
Common mathematical symbols.
Currency symbols.

Factory function that creates a character/icon lookup formatter.

The returned function resolves a semantic name to its Unicode glyph. Names are
dotted paths into the {@link Icon} map (e.g. `'icon.circle.open'`), common
aliases (`'check'`, `'left'`, `'star'`, `'warning'`, ...), the slash forms and
bare keys of the char constants (`'1/2'`, `'plusMinus'`, `'dollar'`), or a
glyph itself. Matching is case-insensitive for dotted paths and bare keys.
Unknown names resolve to an empty string.
Direction names used for arrow and sort indicators.

A curated set of Unicode glyphs for common UI states, grouped by category.
The nesting is arbitrary; use {@link IconValues} or `char()` from
`./char.ts` for flat lookups.
Flat union of all icon glyphs ('○' | '●' | '‧' | ... | '☆').
All icon glyphs as a flat array.
Type guard that checks whether a value is one of the {@link Icon} glyphs.
